questions.q: Sharing the app with the right people is not enough to protect deal data. Why?
options: App sharing only works for administrators
Dashboards cannot be shared
App sharing controls who can open the app, not which rows a query returns; row-level security on each dataset does that
Datasets ignore who the viewer is by design
questions.explain: App sharing and row-level security answer different questions. If the dataset returns all rows, anyone who can open the app sees them.

Returns all rows to every user
Deletes rows owned by the user
Returns rows from every region
questions.explain: The predicate compares each row's OwnerId to the current user's ID, so a user only sees rows they own.

questions.q: In the capstone, why is the Region_Scope__c user field left blank for sales reps?
options: Because reps are not allowed to log in
So reps match only on the owner clause instead of gaining region-wide access
Because blank values give access to every row
Because Salesforce forbids fields on reps
questions.explain: Only regional VPs have a region scope. If reps had one, the OR clause would give them every deal in the region. Also verify no dataset row has a blank Region.

questions.q: The Americas, EMEA, and APAC VPs see $2.9M, $1.5M, and $0.8M, but the executive rollup shows $5.6M. What does this indicate?
options: Everything is correct
The rollup should always be higher
Executives must have a different quarter
A predicate or dataset is leaking or over-filtering, so investigate before launch
questions.explain: The regions add up to $5.2M. A mismatch means one side has a security or filtering error that the test matrix has exposed.

questions.q: Why did Cobalt Ridge choose security predicates over sharing inheritance for this app?
options: Inheritance is unavailable in all orgs
Predicates run faster on every dataset
Predicates are required by Data Cloud
The region rule is a custom business rule and the usage data comes from outside Salesforce
questions.explain: Inheritance mirrors native Salesforce sharing for supported objects. Custom rules and external data need predicates. Check current documentation for what inheritance supports.
